english.title: Use a vehicle / trailer on a road and fail to equip it with sufficient and suitable springs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[a trailer]_

when the springs between each wheel and the frame of the

(C)_[vehicle]_
(D)_[trailer]_

were not suitable and sufficient to conform to the requirement of regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(iii) Regulation 22(3) provides that this regulation DOES NOT APPLY to-
(a) a wheeled vehicle with an unladen weight not exceeding 4070 kg and which is-
(i) a motor tractor any unsprung wheel of which is fitted with a pneumatic tyre;
(ii) a motor tractor used in connection with railway shunting and which is used on a road only when passing from one railway track to another in connection with such use,
(iii) a vehicle specially designed, and mainly used, for work on rough ground or unmade roads and every wheel of which is fitted with a pneumatic tyre and which is not driven at more than 20 mph,
(iv) a vehicle constructed or adapted for, and being used for, road sweeping and every wheel of which is fitted with either a pneumatic tyre or a resilient tyre and which is not driven at more than 20 mph,
(b) an agricultural motor vehicle which is not driven at more than 20 mph;
(c) an agricultural trailer, or an agricultural trailed appliance;
(d) a trailer used solely for the haulage of felled trees;
(e) a motor cycle;
(f) a mobile crane;
(g) a pedestrian-controlled vehicle all the wheels of which are equipped with pneumatic tyres;
(h) a road roller;
(i) a broken down vehicle; or
(j) a vehicle first used on or before 1st January 1932.
(iv) Regulation 22(4) provides that this offence DOES NOT APPLY to a works truck or a works trailer.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months
